assign.card: core/Item: every data-shapes build on one branch, fixed and tested together (integration 2, not merged)

findings.text: The two-tab check's "each change shown once" is not met for the edit, and report.md's table says it is. proof/twotab-new.txt and twotab-old.txt both give `edit: shown_in_B 0, shown_in_A 0`; the text only appears after the next move. The "Left" section admits it, but the table cell claims "each change shown once in both tabs". Make the table say "add and move shown once; an edit shows only at the next list change (same on michael/dev)", so the owner's post-merge two-tab check doesn't look like a regression.

The landing report isn't committed or indexed. `report.md` and `review/` are untracked (`git status`: `?? …/integration-2/report.md`), and the task's `files.jsonl` doesn't list `report.md`. The committed repo is the source of truth (law 5), and anything unindexed is forgotten (law 10). Commit both and add `{"file":"report.md"}`.

The worktree has 39 uncommitted `files.jsonl` edits that only add `"gone":true` lines (e.g. `public/framework/ai/files.jsonl`: usage.json, page-work.json, state.json … gone). They're dev-server listing noise: those files are gitignored and absent in a worktree. If they get swept into a commit or the merge, real listings on michael/dev get marked gone. Revert them (`git checkout -- '*files.jsonl'`, keeping the task's own `session.jsonl`) and say so in the merge note.

The voice check's "each redraw cheap" is not met: proof/voice.txt shows 40 redraws with median 94 ms and max 154 ms, plus long tasks up to 376 ms while streaming. report.md says this honestly and filed it on core/Session. It's still a "no" on an owner check, so the merge note should list it as a known gap. The new `"read"` listener also re-walks every DefaultView subject under the tree's top on each batch (`DefaultView.listen_read`), which adds to this cost on long session pages.

plan.md isn't updated with the outcome. Its integration-2 row (plan.md:119) still reads "spawned 22:13" and doesn't link to report.md or give the branch's state. A fresh agent starting from plan.md wouldn't learn that integration 2 landed, is ready to merge, or which gaps it left.

`item.move_to({url, path})` doesn't move anything itself. It only sets the forward (Item.js `move_to`), and `move_item` in page_tools.js still does the file move, then calls `kid.move_to()` to build the forward line. The handoff does use it, as asked, but "one verb that moves, re-paths and forwards" holds only for a move inside a file (`move_to(list)`). Say this in the Item.move_to comment or in doc/ref.md.

The arrival fix (`f66776eef`, Ref.settle `next === hit`) also treats a genuinely self-pointing forward (bad data) as arrival instead of an error. That's fine for now; worth one line in doc/ref.md's Forwards.
`ux/Content/Object/doc/default-view.md` doesn't mention the `"read"` redraw. Only the readme's Watch out line has it.

No shots were given. `shots/` is empty, although session.jsonl logs a shots line with 11 pages and widths 400/1200/1920/3440, and no layout.json exists. The page systems below are judged from two headless shots of my own (`/framework/core/Test/view/?test=Task` at 1200, `/framework/core/Item/` at 400). Every `[measured]` answer is `not measured`. This is a review.mjs fault to log; it is not this task's fault.
